scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A nondegenerate counterexample to the Morse-number Arnold bound” (preprints/A-nondegenerate-counterexample-to-the-Morse-number-Arnold-bound-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 347 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f7980995971b08df), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist a closed connected symplectic manifold (M, ω) of real dimen- sion twelve and a smooth one-periodic Hamiltonian H such that every fixed point of ϕ1 H is nondegenerate and # Fix0(ϕ1 H; H) = # Fix(ϕ1 H) = χ(M) + 128 < Morse(M).
